subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's bootstrap tradeoff: a yielding full-tree glob walker plus yielded bootstrap hook dispatch to keep channel I/O responsive while preserving configured bootstrap matches?
rationale: The code path is a real P1 bug fix and I found no concrete patch defect, but the PR changes compatibility-sensitive bootstrap glob resolution and hook scheduling semantics that maintainers must intentionally own before merge.

options.title: Accept and land after gates
options.body: Accept the internal yielding/full-walk behavior as the right bug-fix tradeoff once exact-head required CI/Testbox gates are green.

options.title: Ask for live channel proof
options.body: Request one more live embedded_run/channel proof if maintainers want production-like evidence beyond the focused terminal liveness and Docker test output.

options.title: Pause for narrower policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer a different broad-glob policy such as explicit pruning, limits, or configuration rather than preserving every configured match.

recommendation.title: Accept and land after gates
recommendation.body: Accept the internal yielding/full-walk behavior as the right bug-fix tradeoff once exact-head required CI/Testbox gates are green.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal ties steipete to bootstrap read boundaries, hook contracts, and agent bootstrap helpers affected by this tradeoff.
